The direct editor dependency is quill@2.0.3. ReactQuill and its nested quill@1.3.7 copy have been removed. Corporate email sanitizes editor HTML with DOMPurify before send; remove this exception when Quill publishes a patched 2.x release or a tested downgrade to 2.0.2 is approved.

This is pulled through both exceljs@4.4.0 -> uuid@8.3.2 and @capacitor/assets 3.0.5 -> @trapezedev/project -> xcode -> uuid@7.0.3. The app does not pass caller-controlled buffers to uuid v3/v5/v6 through these libraries, and npm audit's ExcelJS fix path downgrades to 3.4.0; remove this exception only after both dependency paths resolve to a non-vulnerable uuid range.

GHSA-qwww-vcr4-c8h2 (React Router RSC Mode CSRF Bypass) only affects apps that opt into React Router's RSC/framework server-rendering mode (unstable_RSC, server actions). This app is a client-side Vite SPA using react-router-dom as a plain client router -- no RSC APIs are imported anywhere in src/. react-router-dom is already at its latest release (7.18.1); the only 'fix' npm audit offers is downgrading to 7.11.0, which reintroduces multiple other high-severity advisories (e.g. GHSA-chx6-hx7r-mcp5, GHSA-337j-9hxr-rhxg) that are only patched at >=7.18.0, so no version currently clears the full advisory set. Re-review when React Router publishes a release that patches GHSA-qwww-vcr4-c8h2 without regressing the later fixes.
